purpose.zh: 拉伸后腿的髋前侧和大腿前侧
purpose.en: Stretch the front of the back-leg hip and thigh.

text.zh: 上身挺直，骨盆后卷向前送
text.en: Sit tall, tuck your pelvis, and shift it gently forward

text.zh: 后脚脚背搭在矮凳上，前脚踩稳
text.en: Rest the top of your back foot on the stool and plant the front foot.

text.zh: 髋前侧有拉伸感就停住呼吸
text.en: Stop and breathe once you feel the stretch in the front of the hip.

commonErrors.zh: 腰往后仰代替骨盆后卷
commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back instead of tucking the pelvis.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒适的程度，出现疼痛就放松
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.

cautions.zh: 后膝下垫软垫；膝盖不适就减小幅度
cautions.en: Pad under your back knee, and reduce the range if the knee feels uncomfortable.
